notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
Hi guys, here are the new update!

It includes:
Minor bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Some descriptions are now more specific.
[*] Exp is now correctly retained.
[*] Unlocked equipment screen no longer glitches.
[/list]

Rebalance:
[list]
[*] Boss stats have been balanced, mainly to avoid getting stuck, their defense has been lowered considerably and their health increased.
[*] Event windows are now a bit smaller.
[*] The game now starts in one of two dimensions at random.
[/list]
 Quality of life and feedback additions:
[list]
[*] Changed the “Back to Main Menu” button to “Surrender” to preserve exp from that run.
[*] Changed the base speed of combat to a higher speed. (You can still lower it if you need to)
[*] Hud animation when gaining/changing passive ability
[*] Hud animation when equipping/changing an item
[*] Numeric pop up when gaining or losing permanent stats. For more clarity with event results.
[/list]

notes.title: New content update!
notes.notes:
Hi here is the new update!
It adds:
[list]
[*] Steam cloud support
[*] 25 new events
[*] 16 new passive skills/curses
[*] 12 new consumable objects
[/list]
So right now the game has:
63 events in total (playable, not counting the main story events)
39 passive skills/curses
112 total objects ( 30 consumables + 82 equipment)

I tried to do my best testing all but in case there is any bug that remains, as you already know, I pay attention to community posts to fix any problem that may arise.

So don't hesitate to report any problems you could find.

notes.title: Story, new objects & game feel update!
notes.notes:
Hello! 
Have been a hard work but here I'm with the new update.
[list]
[*] The core of the Story of the game have been added.
[*] Also new items have been added, now are double than the last version.
[*] You will unlock them playing and gaining exp (The demo is capped to the lvl 2 of unlocks)
[*] Some bosses have been reworked and other some small changes in the skills.
[*] All the game have been polished and have been added some effects to increase the game feeling.
[*] For all habilities & pasive skills have been added icons/representations. And now you can see what pasives (and his info) you got in the left of the screen.
[*] Finally, some fx have been added and a lot of minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Hope you like it!

notes.title: Passive skills added & minor bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I've added some passive skills in order to give you more versatility and deeper strategies.
For now you will get them between floors, like the abilities.

Hope you like it!

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The energy system has been updated. Now the cost of some of the abilities are modified by the cost of the base attack/weapon.

Also the HUD of the abilities has been updated too. Now you can read the energy cost and total damage (and the total damage before altered effects hace been applied if you are in combat) and how it works (For example, Damage = Attack * 0.8)

And I change some stats of the enemies, them should be a little more tough now.

Some bugs have been fixed:
-Some item had the texts wrong.
-Mask of pain functions.
-If you use the ingame button the velocity didn't got saved between battles
-"Esc" bug when ended the intro and just starting the world.
-Other minor bugs.

notes.title: New Screenshots + Development Update 8/8/2024
notes.notes:
Hello! As a solodev I have to manage my time well, so I don't post much here. But today I bring you new information (and new screenshots, updated in the store!).

[h2]NEW STUFF:[/h2]
I have added an [b]energy system[/b] to combat. Allowing you to [b]chain various actions[/b], only having to load the action time (skipping the waiting time).
Each type of weapon has different energy costs. From daggers chaining small attacks, to axes with a much greater energy expenditure.
The idea is to give more speed and depth to the combats. I hope you like this system!

I have also added [b]consumable items[/b], they simply seem like a must in a game like this.

I have [b]added critical and evasion stats[/b] to the game design.
At first I wanted to avoid rng within combat, but testing the combat I came to the conclusion that it could be more interesting with crits and evasion. (in addition to being able to add builds and cool synergies)

[h2]ROADMAP[/h2]
Regarding the future of the game:
I would like to have a demo soon so I can have feedback and so you can try the game.
And if everything goes well, the demo has good feedback, polish it well and be able to bring you Early Access by the end of 2024 or so.

And that's all for now. Any feedback is welcome! <3
